description: Evaluate and test backend and frontend software with the evidence-driven test evaluation algorithm (inventory, risk, run, coverage, smells, mutation, API contract).

gates.description: Stack, layers, runners, existing tests and the recommended test-portfolio shape
Rank files by risk = likelihood x impact (churn, fixes, complexity, coverage, critical domain)
Run the project's tests N times; fail on failing, flaky or zero executed tests
Diff coverage of changed lines (default >= 80%) and optional total coverage
Assurance filters for new tests: F1 builds, F2 stable in 5/5 runs, F3 adds coverage, F4 no smells (run per new test with --scope)
Test smells: focused/empty tests fail; sleepy, assertion-free, skipped and others are reported
Mutation score on high-risk files (StrykerJS / mutmut); surviving mutants become test targets
Property-based API contract testing from the OpenAPI spec (Schemathesis)
